title: Rollouts integration: attach shadow experiments to canary/A-B and surface quality results in rollout timeline
creator: Talia Benson
project: Shadow traffic tool for eval metrics
description:
## Context
Shadow traffic experiments are being introduced to measure quality deltas during model/version/config rollouts without impacting user-visible responses. This ticket covers the integration layer between **Rollouts** (canary + A/B) and **Shadow Experiments** so that:
- a rollout can reference one (or more) shadow experiment configs
- a rollout timeline can show quality deltas (and scoring health) alongside latency/cost/error signals
- the operator experience remains "safe by default" (advisory quality signals at launch; no automatic rollback in v1)

This is intentionally a **linkage + UX surfacing** effort; creation/query of shadow experiments is tracked in ENG-5407/ENG-5408.

## Problem
Today rollouts provide strong latency/cost/error observability, but quality regressions require manual/offline evaluation. Operators want to attach a shadow experiment to a rollout and monitor quality deltas in the same workflow they use to decide whether to proceed/roll back.

## Requirements (v1)
### Functional
1) **Attach shadow experiment(s) to a rollout**
- Support both canary and A/B rollout types.
- A rollout should be able to reference:
  - an existing shadow experiment (created earlier), OR
  - a shadow experiment created in the rollout flow (Console work; here we only ensure the backend model supports linking).

2) **Expose quality results in rollout timeline**
- Add a timeline event/card that summarizes the experiment state and key deltas:
  - overall score deltas (e.g., rubric aggregate) + confidence interval
  - refusal/safety rate delta
  - format adherence delta
  - scoring lag / % scored (pipeline health)
- Provide a deep link into the Shadow Experiment results page.

3) **Permissions and auditability**
- Rollout viewers with existing rollout read access can see linked experiment summary.
- Editing linked experiments requires rollout edit permission (same as modifying rollout steps).
- All linkage/changes should generate audit log entries (covered by ENG-5417; ensure we emit the new action types).

4) **Fail-open / degraded mode**
- If scoring is down or results are missing, the rollout UI must show "Quality data unavailable" (non-blocking) and never prevent serving.
- Backend should tolerate missing/partial aggregates (avoid failing Rollout GET/Timeline fetch).

### Non-functional
- Cardinality-safe: no per-request examples in rollout timeline; only aggregated experiment metrics.
- Efficient queries: avoid hot loops across experiments for a list of rollouts.
- Backward compatible: existing rollouts must not require migration to load.

## Out of scope (v1)
- Automatic rollback based on quality thresholds (tracked in PM-1846; plan is advisory-only at launch).
- Arbitrary join of multiple experiments into a single “quality gate” object.
- Custom customer scoring code execution.

## Proposed approach
### Data model changes
Add optional fields to Rollout model (control plane / rollout service DB) to represent linkage.
- `shadow_experiment_ids`: list of shadow experiment IDs attached to the rollout
- `shadow_experiment_primary_id`: optional “primary” experiment used for timeline summary (for v1; avoids unclear UI if multiple are attached)

Notes:
- Keep it flexible for future “multiple shadow targets” per rollout, but keep v1 UI summarized.
- For A/B rollouts, the shadow experiment is still defined relative to the user-facing control response. The experiment itself carries control vs shadow targets; rollout just references it.

### API changes (Rollouts service)
1) Update Rollout create/update endpoints to accept `shadow_experiment_ids` (behind feature flag).
- Validate that each referenced experiment:
  - belongs to same org/tenant
  - targets the same route as the rollout (or a child route) to avoid accidental cross-route linking
  - is in a compatible state (e.g., created/active; do not require "completed")

2) Timeline endpoint: enrich rollout timeline response with a “Shadow Quality Summary” block
- Fetch latest aggregates for `shadow_experiment_primary_id`:
  - window: last 1h + last 24h (UI can pick default; backend provides both)
  - include confidence interval fields where available
  - include scoring health: queue lag, % scored, last scored timestamp

Implementation detail:
- Do not compute aggregates in Rollouts service. Consume from the Shadow Experiments aggregate API (ENG-5407) or from the analytics store via a small internal client.
- Cache summary for short TTL (e.g., 30s–60s) to reduce burst load during incident/rollout war rooms.

### Console UX (informational)
Console ticket(s) will render a timeline card:
- Title: "Shadow quality check"
- State pill: Active / Completed / No data / Degraded
- Top-line deltas (primary score + refusal + format adherence)
- Health line: "Scoring lag: X min" and "% scored"
- CTA: "View experiment" deep link

This ticket must ensure the backend supports what Console needs; UX specifics tracked in DES-611/DES-612 and ENG-5408.

## Acceptance criteria
- Rollout objects can be created/updated with a linked shadow experiment (feature-flagged).
- Rollout timeline API returns a new timeline item summarizing the linked shadow experiment with:
  - experiment id + name
  - status
  - aggregate deltas for at least 1h and 24h windows
  - confidence interval representation (if present) OR explicit "CI unavailable"
  - scoring pipeline health (lag/% scored)
  - deep link URL
- If experiment aggregates are unavailable, rollout timeline still loads successfully with a degraded summary.
- RBAC enforced: only authorized users can edit linkage.
- Unit tests and integration tests cover:
  - tenant mismatch rejection
  - route mismatch rejection
  - missing aggregates (no hard failure)
  - feature flag off (ignored fields)

## Implementation checklist
- [x] Add Rollout schema fields + DB migration (nullable)
- [x] Add validation rules for linking experiment IDs
- [x] Implement internal client call to shadow experiment aggregates
- [x] Add timeline item type: `SHADOW_QUALITY_SUMMARY`
- [x] Add caching/timeout + fail-open behavior
- [ ] Wire audit log action type(s) for attach/detach (coordinate with ENG-5417)
- [ ] Integration tests in rollout service CI
- [ ] Update internal API docs / protobuf comments

## Open questions
1) Multiple experiments per rollout: For v1, do we restrict to 1, or allow many but summarize primary only?
- Proposal: allow list, summarize primary, enforce primary must be in list.

2) Window selection: Should we standardize on 15m/1h/24h?
- Proposal: provide 1h + 24h now (matches common rollout decision windows); Console can add 15m later.

3) What counts as "Degraded"?
- Proposal: if `scoring_lag_minutes > 15` OR `%scored < 70%` over last hour OR no aggregates received in last 30m.
- Coordinate thresholds with SRE guardrails doc (shadow traffic SLOs).

## Risks / mitigations
- Risk: Rollout timeline becomes slow due to aggregate fetch.
  - Mitigation: strict timeout (<=250ms) + cache; on timeout return degraded card.
- Risk: Cross-route linking causes confusing deltas.
  - Mitigation: validate route_id matches; show route name in summary.
- Risk: UI implies quality gating is automatic.
  - Mitigation: copy/labeling in Console: "advisory"; no rollout step blocking in v1.

## Rollout plan
- Stage 1: enable feature flag for internal dogfood tenant only; validate timeline card shows aggregates and degrades gracefully.
- Stage 2: enable for beta Dedicated tenants selected by Product; monitor rollout timeline latency and error rates.
- Stage 3: GA with docs + oncall runbook link in Console.
comments: 2026-01-16 (Paula Mendes): Please ensure v1 is advisory-only. We should not block a rollout step based on quality deltas until we have calibrated thresholds + clear customer consent. Linking + surfacing is the must-have for beta.

2026-01-20 (Chloe Martin): Console backend can consume either the shadow experiments aggregate API or a direct analytics query. Prefer aggregate API so we don’t duplicate windowing/stat logic in rollouts service. +1 to caching with short TTL.
2026-01-27 (Allison Grant): Watch out for cardinality if you try to include segment breakdowns in the timeline. Timeline should stay top-line only; breakdowns belong on the experiment page/dashboard.

2026-02-03 (Sean Gallagher): For degraded status, keep it simple: scoring lag threshold + last-seen timestamp. Also make sure the timeline endpoint never hard-fails if shadow systems are down; this must be strictly best-effort.

2026-02-11 (Jada Williams): Implemented schema + timeline item behind `shadow_quality_rollout_timeline` flag. Waiting on final aggregate endpoint shape from ENG-5407 before wiring confidence interval fields cleanly. Added 250ms timeout and returns degraded summary on failure.

2026-02-18 (Marcus Lin): Security note: linking IDs is fine, but avoid returning any prompt/response payload refs via the rollout timeline APIs. Aggregates only, please. No extra approval needed if we keep it aggregate-only.

2026-02-21 (Jada Williams): PR up for review in redwood repo (not yet linked in sources). Remaining TODO is to align audit log action types with ENG-5417 so attach/detach shows up in tenant audit trail.
